candidates: When refactoring a function by adding or removing parameters, audit every call site to confirm the argument list matches the updated signature exactly — extra or missing arguments will not always produce a type error if TypeScript is lenient or the file is JavaScript.

When adding telemetry events for multiple variants of the same user action (e.g. several 'share' sub-actions), prefer a single event constant with a discriminating payload field (e.g. `telemetry('share', { action: 'story-link-copied' })`) rather than a separate event constant per variant. Reserve distinct event constants for conceptually independent event types.

Side effects — such as emitting channel events, calling external APIs, or triggering mutations — must be placed inside `useEffect`, never inside `useMemo`. `useMemo` is strictly for computing memoized derived values; React may invoke it at arbitrary times and does not guarantee a single execution per render.
